title: Avoid no-op mutable scans dirtying unchanged persistence metadata collections
outcome: Conservative mutation tracking remains correct, while revalidation passes that change no rows do not unnecessarily select large metadata collections for cloning and encoding.
acceptance: Measure or deterministically demonstrate which no-op mutable scans select unchanged metadata collections, distinguishing encoded footprint from clone time.
Replace confirmed no-op dirtying with shared prescans and targeted mutable access using the existing tracking owner, preserving validation semantics and deadlines.
Focused regression checks and an independent review pair cover the changed mutation paths; no live speedup is asserted without measurement.
